scope: OIF harness practical runtime. Preserve substantive requirements, task evidence and unknown effects. Proportional methods govern research, independent review and learning; this profile grants no external-action authority.

mapping.preserved: User intent, exact sources, scope, all acceptance criteria and permission boundaries
mapping.implementation: Source CAS, explicit acceptance reconciliation, task-relative tools, controller-owned admission

mapping.preserved: Necessary current research and independent challenge
mapping.implementation: Web when the task needs external facts; independent final review for executable/code output, larger changes or explicit review requests; no review of a review

mapping.preserved: Useful knowledge, improvement and honest delivery
mapping.implementation: Persist original outcomes and recurrent faults for reuse; relevant knowledge lookup remains available. No compulsory model learning call or Skill creation after each tool

mapping.preserved: State continuity, first fault, partial success, integrated verification and proof ceilings
mapping.implementation: Durable model/tool intents and results, source-bound continuation, file CAS and readback, preimages, artifact verification, bounded execution, explicit unknown effects
This scoped authorized method replaces blanket per-operation rituals. Successful simple tasks terminate after actual artifact verification; mandatory outcomes remain mandatory

recovery: Preserve task records and exact preimages. Stop active work before changing versions, reconcile incompatible policy identities explicitly, and never automatically replay an unknown effect.
